title: Batching and KV-cache Advisor with Canary Gates and Approval Workflow
creator: Sophie Chen
description: Design and implement a safe delivery path for Optimize recommendations that change batching and KV-cache configuration. The feature provides: (1) a conservative advisor that proposes concrete batching and cache config deltas for a given workload, (2) a gated deployment mechanism that stages changes through canary subsets of traffic, and (3) an approval hook in the Console for operator sign-off before broader rollout. The goal is to reduce per-token cost while preserving latency SLOs and generation quality. This ticket covers design decisions, API surface for suggested-config objects, runtime rollout controller, canary traffic selectors, observability events, and console approval flow. It also defines rollback triggers and automated rollback execution for regressions observed during canary stages.
acceptance_criteria: Advisor proposes batching and KV-cache changes with estimated cost delta and latency delta for a specific route/model
Canary rollout controller can apply suggested config to a configurable subset of traffic (by customer, route, or percentage) without service restart
Console shows a pending suggestion with diffs, estimated impact, and an Approve / Reject / Pause action
Automated monitors detect regression (latency p95, error rate, quality metric) and trigger an observable rollback within configured thresholds
Audit log entry created for every suggested-change action and approval/rollback with actor and timestamps
End-to-end integration tests simulate a canary regression and validate rollback path executes within SLA window
implementation_tasks: Spec: suggested-config schema + fields (batch_size_target, batching_window_ms, kv_cache_ttl_ms, kv_cache_enabled) and cost/latency estimation model
Runtime: implement rollout controller that accepts suggestion refs and applies to traffic selectors atomically
Traffic selectors: support percentage, route-pattern, and customer-id targeting in controller
Observability: emit suggestion.lifecycle events, per-route token cost delta, latency histograms, and quality regressions hooks
Console: UI card for suggestions with diff view, impact estimates, and Approve/Reject/Pause buttons and comments
Approval API: endpoint that records approver identity, justification, and optional expiry for the approval
Rollback rules: configurable thresholds (p95 increase > 20% or error rate +0.5%) and automated rollback actor that reverts configs
E2E tests: synthetic workload harness to validate canary detect-rollback scenario
Docs: runbook for SREs and support; Confluence page with monitoring dashboards and rollback playbook
Security: KMS audit for change records and ensure RBAC gating for Approve actions
rollout_plan: Phase A: feature flag the advisor-only UI (no apply) and collect operator feedback for 2 weeks. Phase B: enable canary controller in staging with 5% traffic selector; run synthetic traffic tests and runbook rehearsals. Phase C: enable canary in prod for internal pilot customers (1-3 customers) behind an invite flag. Phase D: open to all customers with 10% -> 50% -> 100% ramp after manual approvals at each step or automated progression if no regressions are detected for 24h. Each canary step includes automated checks and a manual approval gate in Console before progressing.
monitoring: Dashboards will include per-suggestion panels: token cost, throughput, latency p50/p95/p99, error rate, quality regression score (from eval probe), and canary vs baseline comparison. Alerts: p95 increase > 15% sustained for 10 minutes, error rate delta > 0.5% absolute, quality regression > configured threshold. All alerts surface to #platform-optimize and create an incident with suggestion id attached.
